checks: All 1,380 frozen jobs present exactly once; both seats and both versions complete.
Input and output hashes, replay lengths, terminal cash, wages, overflow, task obligations, invalid actions and 719 decision timings reconciled.
Inference resamples 30 entire paired seed blocks; 1,380 games are not treated as independent samples.
Public-pool results and direct head-to-head results use separate denominators; ties count as half a point only in the direct score.
caveats: Fixed public pool contains similar programs and shared action libraries; this is not a ladder rating.
If every observed paired win difference is zero, the ordinary bootstrap win interval collapses to zero; this is not an equivalence guarantee for unseen seeds or opponents.
Same seed can produce different later shops if policy decisions change the official RNG consumption path; paired differences measure the full closed-loop outcome.
Native host does not enforce competition sandbox decision deadlines; parallel wall times measure contention as well as policy work.
Protected-work audit covers adopted commitments, not every potential agricultural action. Direct matches audit workflow obligations; both versions are audited throughout the public pool.
Numeric seed spread is not a guarantee of all possible board coverage. These are 30 preselected random initializations.
